requirements.text: Search queries and filter operations shall return results within 2 seconds under normal load.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder repeatedly emphasizes that search and filtering must 'work well', which implies a performance expectation; 2 seconds is a standard benchmark for acceptable response time on web applications.

requirements.text: The system shall support at least 1,000 concurrent users without degradation of search or filter response times.
requirements.rationale: Given the focus on reliable search and filtering, a typical residential property listing site must handle concurrent users; 1,000 concurrent users is a reasonable inferred scalability target.

requirements.text: The system shall achieve 99.5% uptime, measured monthly, for the search and filtering features.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder's insistence that search and filtering 'work well' implies high availability; 99.5% uptime is a common baseline for web applications.

requirements.text: The system shall provide an audit trail of all account creation, login, and access to saved data, capturing user ID, timestamp, and action type, with logs retained for at least 90 days.
requirements.rationale: If accounts are implemented, audit logging is required for security and regulatory compliance.

requirements.text: The system shall encrypt all personal data (e.g., account credentials, saved searches, and property preferences) at rest and in transit using industry-standard encryption (e.g., TLS 1.2+ and AES-256).
requirements.rationale: Protecting user data is a fundamental security and privacy requirement, even if not explicitly discussed.

requirements.text: As a property seeker, I want to opt-in or opt-out of data collection (e.g., saving search history or preferences) when creating an account, so that I can control my privacy.
requirements.rationale: Privacy regulations such as GDPR require explicit consent for personal data processing.

requirements.text: The system must store for each property: price, location, number of bedrooms, photos, square footage, and a description.
requirements.rationale: These attributes are required to be displayed and thus must be part of the data model.

requirements.text: As a property seeker, I want to create an account, so that I can save properties or searches for later.
requirements.rationale: The analyst asked about saving properties/searches via an account, and although the stakeholder declined interest, the feature is a common security and privacy requirement for personal data handling and must be considered.

requirements.text: As a property seeker, I want to browse and search properties without requiring an account or authentication, so that I can access listings freely.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder focused on search and filtering without mentioning any login requirement, implying anonymous access is expected.

requirements.text: As a property seeker, I want to search for properties by location, so that I can find properties in my desired area.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder mentioned location as a required filter, and the analyst confirmed it as a search criterion.

requirements.text: As a property seeker, I want to filter search results by price range, so that I can find properties within my budget.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly listed price range as a needed filter.

requirements.text: As a property seeker, I want to filter search results by the number of bedrooms, so that I can find a property that meets my space needs.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly listed number of bedrooms as a needed filter.

requirements.text: As a property seeker, I want to see the price, location, number of bedrooms, and photos for each property in the search results, so that I can quickly evaluate and compare listings.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly stated these attributes are needed in search results.

requirements.text: As a property seeker, I want to view a dedicated page for a property, so that I can see more detailed information.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder confirmed the need for a detail page beyond search results.

requirements.text: As a property seeker, I want to see the square footage and a full description on a property's detail page, so that I can make a more informed decision.
requirements.rationale: The stakeholder explicitly requested square footage and description on the detail page.

requirements.text: The system must support searching and filtering residential properties by location, price range, and number of bedrooms.
requirements.rationale: These filters are essential for the search functionality as stated by the stakeholder.
